facts.fact: ASIN's July 2026 legal note treats Benin's interoperability framework as in place, setting registration, technical and contractual conditions for connecting to the Xroad-BJ exchange platform, with the Comité national d'interopérabilité supervising; the note's date is the published date, 2026-07-28, no event date being given.

systems.owner: ASIN (management and governance); supervised by the Comité national d'interopérabilité
systems.tiers: public administrations and authorised actors; private bodies with adhesion convention and APDP authorisation
